words.en: To perform exceptionally well or be superior to others.
words.ex: Young Indian grandmasters continue to excel in international chess tournaments.

source.headline: All to play for: On the World chess championship in Geneva

words.en: A belief accepted as true without proof or evidence.
words.ex: The project failed because of the wrong assumption about market demand.
words.trick: Assume means to take something for granted.

source.headline: Transfer assumption: On the SAD(B)-BJP alliance in Punjab

words.en: A formal complaint regarding unfair treatment or an injustice.
words.ex: The university set up a portal for students to register their grievance.
words.trick: Grievance sounds like grief from being treated unfairly.

words.en: Logical, consistent, and easy to understand as a whole.
words.ex: The city needs a coherent transport plan to reduce traffic congestion.
words.trick: Co- means together; coherent thoughts stick together logically.

source.headline: Spinning wheels: on urban mobility in Karnataka

words.en: Based on a system of specific beliefs or principles.
words.ex: The two groups had deep ideological differences regarding the education policy.
words.trick: Contains the word idea, relating to political ideas.

source.headline: Dravidian politics in TN temple row

words.en: A temporary alliance formed for joint action or political power.
words.ex: The regional parties formed a coalition to contest the upcoming municipal elections.
words.trick: Co- means together, like a team working together.

source.headline: Out of power since a decade, why BJP-SAD reunion alters Punjab’s poll equation

words.en: A powerful or influential person in a specific industry.
words.ex: The tech mogul announced a massive investment in India's semiconductor sector.
words.trick: Think of the powerful Mughal kings of history.

source.headline: Jensen Huang, Nvidia and the future of AI: 3 key takeaways from the return of a CEO

words.en: Restoring someone or something to their previous position.
words.ex: The workers demanded the reinstatement of the manager who was wrongly fired.
words.trick: Putting someone back in their state again.

source.headline: Mint Quick Edit | What does Jensen Huang's return mean for the AI industry—and Indian stocks?

words.en: To call on or use a rule, law, or power.
words.ex: The administration had to invoke emergency protocols after the sudden flood.
words.trick: Use your voice to call in a rule.

source.headline: The Nvidia board's flip-flop over Jensen Huang is a test of corporate independence in America

words.en: A reward or benefit offered to persuade someone to act.
words.ex: Higher interest rates served as a strong inducement for foreign investors to buy Indian bonds.
words.trick: Think of 'induce' + 'ment'; it is the means used to induce someone into action.

source.headline: The Indian rupee's carry-trade stardom isn't permanent—how long it holds out depends on RBI
